title: Checkout double-click on a skillet, duplicate lands exactly on the $50.00 auto limit

persona.style: polite, a little apologetic about bothering support

hiddenGoal: Get the second $50.00 charge on the skillet order refunded; keep the skillet.
knownFacts: Order ORD-1110 placed 2026-10-10 for a 12in cast iron skillet
Clicked the pay button twice because the page froze
Bank app shows two $50.00 charges on 2026-10-10, less than a minute apart
Skillet arrived fine on 2026-10-14
Also has an older lantern order from April that is fine
openingMessage: Hi there, sorry to bother you. I think I got charged twice for my skillet order ORD-1110, my bank shows two $50 charges on the same day. Could you check?
authoringNotes: Billing is claim-date governed: claim 2026-10-16 -> BILLING_DISPUTES 2026.1 (24h capture window, 120-day report window) and APPROVAL_AUTHORITY 2026.1 (auto limit $50.00 for a standard customer). ORD-1110 total = SKL-CI-12 4200 + shipping 800 = 5000. Ledger (§2.3): two captures of 5000 at 2026-10-10T14:02:11Z and 14:02:58Z, 47 s apart (inside 24h) -> one duplicate = 5000 x (2-1) = 5000. Age from the capture date 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-16 = 6 days <= 120. Refund exactly the duplicate, 5000 (§2.5). Exposure 5000 is not above the 5000 limit (§6.1: '$50.00 or less' is automatic; gate routes to a human only when total > limit) -> auto-approved, no pause. ORD-1111 (single capture of 2 x 2600 + 600 = 5800) is noise and must not be touched.

title: Platinum multi-item order captured twice by a processor retry; $96.00 duplicate clears the VIP limit

persona.style: terse and busy, writes in short clipped sentences

hiddenGoal: Get the duplicate $96.00 refunded today; ideally also get something extra for the hassle, but drop it if told no.
knownFacts: Order ORD-1120 placed the evening of 2026-09-28: mug set, pour-over set and a solar lantern
Card statement shows $96.00 on 2026-09-28 and another $96.00 the next morning
Everything arrived on 2026-10-02 in good shape
Has been a Platinum member since 2020
Wants a bit of store credit for the trouble
openingMessage: ORD-1120. Charged $96 twice. Fix it, and I'd expect something for the hassle.

referencePlan.reason: No extra credit on top of the billing correction: §2.5 excludes added compensation and §5.1 reserves goodwill for problems no policy remedy covers; the duplicate refund is the remedy.

authoringNotes: Claim 2026-10-16 -> BILLING_DISPUTES 2026.1 and APPROVAL_AUTHORITY 2026.1. ORD-1120 total = MUG-STN-04 3600 + KIT-POUR-02 3400 + OUT-LNT-01 2600 + shipping 0 = 9600. Captures of 9600 at 2026-09-28T19:40:05Z and 2026-09-29T07:12:44Z = 11h32m39s apart (inside 24h) -> one duplicate of 9600. Age from 2026-09-29 = 1 + 16 = 17 days <= 120. Refund 9600. Platinum is the VIP tier -> auto limit $100.00 (§6.2); 9600 <= 10000 -> auto-approved (a standard or gold customer would pause, 9600 > 5000). The 'something for the hassle' ask is declined (deny is info only): §2.5 forbids adding compensation to a billing refund and §5.1 says goodwill is for issues no policy remedy covers. Trap: a $20.00 goodwill credit would pass the goodwill checks for Platinum but push exposure to 11600 > 10000 and is not policy-supported here. Fixture fix: tracking now starts after the 19:40Z capture (label 2026-09-29), not before the order was paid.

title: Gold customer says four charges, ledger shows three; two duplicates combined into one refund over the auto limit

persona.style: chatty and confident, leans on Gold membership perks

hiddenGoal: Get every extra charge on the pour-over order back right away; thinks Gold status should skip any review.
knownFacts: Order ORD-1130 placed 2026-10-01 for a ceramic pour-over set
Checkout kept showing an error so pressed pay again a few times
The bank app lists three $41.00 charges on 2026-10-01 (the 'like four' was a guess from memory)
The pour-over set arrived fine on 2026-10-05
Believes Gold members get instant VIP approval
openingMessage: Hiya! Your checkout went haywire on ORD-1130 and charged me like four times for one pour-over set. I'm a Gold member so I assume you can just push the refund through instantly?
authoringNotes: Claim 2026-10-16 -> BILLING_DISPUTES 2026.1, APPROVAL_AUTHORITY 2026.1. ORD-1130 total = KIT-POUR-02 3400 + shipping 700 = 4100. Ledger has THREE captures of 4100 (16:45:10, 16:45:52, 17:03:30 on 2026-10-01; gaps 42 s and 17m38s, all inside 24h), not the four the customer claims -> the plan follows the ledger (§2.3). Duplicates = 4100 x (3 - 1) = 8200, combined into one refund (§6.4); the original 4100 stays (§2.5). Age 2026-10-01 -> 2026-10-16 = 15 days <= 120. Gold is NOT a VIP tier (vipTiers = platinum only, §6.2), so the limit is $50.00 (§6.1); 8200 > 5000 -> pauses for a supervisor, who approves.

title: Thermostat still in transit; the 'second charge' is a pending authorization hold, ledger shows one capture

persona.style: anxious, worried the card was compromised

hiddenGoal: Have the second $179.00 charge removed; would be satisfied with a clear explanation that it is only a hold.

Banking app lists two $179.00 lines for the store; one of them is marked 'pending'
The thermostat has not arrived yet; tracking says in transit
Only clicked pay once
openingMessage: Hello, I'm a bit worried. My banking app shows two charges of $179 from you for my thermostat order ORD-1140. Was I charged twice? Should I cancel my card?

referencePlan.reason: The payment ledger shows a single $179.00 capture on ORD-1140; the second line is a temporary authorization hold that the bank releases, not a charge (§2.3, §2.4).

authoringNotes: Claim 2026-10-16 -> BILLING_DISPUTES 2026.1. ORD-1140 total = ELC-THM-01 17900 + shipping 0 = 17900. Ledger: ONE capture of 17900 (2026-10-13T19:58:31Z), so findDuplicateCapture returns null and any duplicate_charge refund fails DOUBLE_CHARGE_CONFIRMED (hard). The second line the customer sees is an authorization hold (§2.4: holds are never refunded; the bank releases them, no date promised). §2.3: the banking-app view does not confirm a duplicate. Reference = deny with an explanation; no money moves, nothing pauses (supervisorPolicy unused). Order is still in transit and not yet due (promised 2026-10-18), so there is no delivery issue either.

title: Customer insists the lamp was charged twice the same day; ledger shows a split-shipment charge and a separate July order

persona.style: combative, quick to accuse, threatens a bad review

hiddenGoal: Get $119.00 back on ORD-1150 by claiming the lamp was double-charged, even though the second $119.00 was a different order.
knownFacts: Order ORD-1150 placed 2026-09-22: brass table lamp and a solar lantern; the lantern was backordered and shipped separately
Card was charged $119.00 on 2026-09-22 and $26.00 on 2026-09-26 for ORD-1150
Also bought a second brass lamp on ORD-1151 on 2026-07-08 for $119.00
Will claim both $119.00 charges were on the same day; the statement actually shows 2026-07-08 and 2026-09-22
Has a screenshot of the September statement only
openingMessage: You people charged me $119 TWICE for one brass lamp on ORD-1150. I have the screenshot. Refund the second charge now or I'm leaving a review everywhere.

referencePlan.reason: No duplicate capture: ORD-1150 was charged $119.00 and $26.00 (different amounts, split shipment), and the other $119.00 is a separate order, ORD-1151 (§2.1, §2.3).
Customer demands a $119.00 refund on ORD-1150 that the ledger does not support and threatens reviews; factual summary for supervisor review (§5.4).

authoringNotes: Claim 2026-10-16 -> BILLING_DISPUTES 2026.1. ORD-1150 total = LGT-BRS-01 11900 + OUT-LNT-01 2600 + shipping 0 = 14500; captures 11900 (2026-09-22) + 2600 (2026-09-26, backordered lantern charged on shipment) = 14500, so paid equals the total. Amounts differ -> not a duplicate under §2.1 (and 3d20h43m apart, outside 24h anyway). The second $119.00 on the statement is ORD-1151 (LGT-BRS-01 11900, single capture 2026-07-08), a separate purchase 76 days earlier. The screenshot does not confirm a duplicate (§2.3) and the 'same day' claim is false. The review threat changes nothing the agent can approve, and §5.4 says an out-of-policy demand under that pressure is escalated with a factual summary, never granted. Reference = deny + escalate; no refund on either order. A duplicate_charge refund on ORD-1150 or ORD-1151 would fail DOUBLE_CHARGE_CONFIRMED (hard), so no exception path exists.

authoringNotes: Claim 2026-10-16 -> BILLING_DISPUTES 2026.1 (120 days from the capture date). ORD-1160 total = ELC-SPK-02 22900 + shipping 0 = 22900; captures of 22900 at 2026-05-30T21:15:40Z and 2026-05-31T09:02:13Z (11h46m33s apart) -> a real duplicate of 22900. Window counts from the duplicate capture: 2026-05-31 -> 2026-10-16 = 30 + 31 + 31 + 30 + 16 = 138 days > 120 -> REPORTED_IN_TIME fails -> deny. Platinum tier does not extend billing windows. The customer hints at cancelling, so per §5.4 the out-of-policy request is escalated with a factual summary rather than granted. If the agent instead proposes refund 22900 with exception=true (soft failure + Platinum -> NEEDS_HUMAN, POLICY_EXCEPTION_REQUESTED), the supervisor rejects and no money moves. Goodwill is not part of the reference: the customer declines credit as a substitute. Reference final state: no refund, ticket escalated. title: Backorder from December 2025 double-charged at shipment; reported on day 120, the last day of the billing window

persona.style: self-deprecating, assumes he is too late

hiddenGoal: Get the extra $103.00 back if at all possible; expects to be told the order is too old.

Card was only charged when it shipped: two $103.00 charges on 2026-06-18, morning and evening

openingMessage: This is probably a long shot. My pendant light order ORD-1170 is from last December. It was backordered, and when it finally shipped in June I got charged $103 twice. The order is almost ten months old so I'm guessing it's too late, but figured I'd ask.
authoringNotes: Temporal + boundary trap. The order date 2025-12-30 falls under 2025.1 (whose §2.2 allowed 90 days), but billing disputes follow the CLAIM date: 2026-10-16 -> BILLING_DISPUTES 2026.1, 120 days counted from the capture date, not the order date. ORD-1170 total = LGT-PND-03 9400 + shipping 900 = 10300. Captures of 10300 at 2026-06-18T07:55Z and 19:20Z (11h25m apart, inside 24h) -> one duplicate of 10300. Age 2026-06-18 -> 2026-10-16 = 12 + 31 + 31 + 30 + 16 = 120 days <= 120 -> in time on the last day (inclusive). Wrong turns: counting from the order date gives 290 days; applying 2025.1 gives 90 -> both would wrongly deny. Refund exactly 10300 (§2.5). Standard tier, auto limit $50.00 (§6.1); 10300 > 5000 -> pauses for a supervisor, who approves. Reworked from a day-113 '90-day quote' case that duplicated ev-029.
